caption:
Your leads live in five different places right now.

A notebook. A spreadsheet. Text threads. Your memory. Maybe a CRM you tried once and abandoned.

Black Arrow OS puts them in one pipeline you can run this week:

1. Drag each lead through stages as they move
2. Schedule the next follow-up so nothing sits untouched
3. Check the KPI dashboard for cost per lead and ROAS
4. Export everything to CSV whenever you want

It's the free edition of the same system behind the full Platform. No signup, no card, 25 contacts free.

Load in every lead you're tracking somewhere else. By Friday you'll know which ones are stalling.
